QUOTE: Bignum. `library/bignum_core.c` uses it for conditional select and compare. `library/bignum.c` references it 26 times and `library/rsa.c` 37 times. Symmetric and AEAD. `ccm.c`, `gcm.c`, `chachapoly.c`, `cmac.c`, `cipher.c`, `nist_kw.c`, `base64.c`. TLS and PSA. `ssl_msg.c`, `ssl_tls.c`, `ssl_tls12_*.c`, `ssl_tls13_*.c`, `ssl_cookie.c`, `psa_crypto*.c`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer lists many consumer modules across bignum, RSA, symmetric/AEAD, TLS and PSA (roughly twenty files), conveying broad use rather than confinement to one or two.
